_readme: Draft Polebrook walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: Back to the Kings Arms

layers.essential_history: [[c:Back where you started. In 1943 this small village was next door to one of the busiest airfields in England.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Every year people come to Polebrook to remember the men of the 351st Bomb Group.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The film crew, the airman, the Land Girl, the landlord and Mr Pryce are all here. Who took the reel?]]

directions_to_next: [[c:That's the end of the walk. Well done, detective!]]

puzzle.title: [[c:Who took the reel?]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Look through your evidence notebook, then make your accusation.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Who took it, why, and where is it now?]]

fields.label: Why?
options: To sell the pictures of the airfield to the enemy
To keep a film star's autograph
To use the tin for sweets
fields.answer: To sell the pictures of the airfield to the enemy

fields.label: Where is it now?
options: In his suitcase at the inn
fields.answer: In his suitcase at the inn

hints: [[c:Who was out of his room at one in the morning?]]
[[c:Who was seen at the airfield fence with a camera?]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It was Mr Leonard Pryce, who was no salesman at all. He took the reel to sell pictures of the airfield, and hid it in his suitcase at the inn. The military police arrive in time, and the reel goes back to the film crew.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:You can solve this from your notebook alone.]]
